text: 房地产进入存量时代；美欧日时隔20年同步加息｜一周热点回顾 8月供强需弱格局延续，债券和股票在社融增量中的占比超50%。
text_en: Real estate enters the stock era; US, Europe and Japan raise rates simultaneously for the first time in 20 years | Weekly hotspot review: In August, the pattern of strong supply and weak demand continued, with bonds and stocks accounting for more than 50% of the increase in aggregate financing.
